findings.problem: The hint rules out mindestens, but zumindest and immerhin are just as common and natural for at least as a consolation (aber zumindest/immerhin ist es warm), so the prompt has more than one right answer.
findings.fix: hint: as a consolation, not with numbers; the everyday word built on wenig (a little), not zumindest or immerhin

back.target: at least (anyway, at any rate; as a consolation)
back.example: It's raining, but at least it's warm.

note: Wenigstens is used across Austria and Switzerland too, so a null regional is right.
